WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    CAST(SUBSTR(date, INSTR(date, '/') + INSTR(SUBSTR(date, INSTR(date, '/') + 1), '/') + 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(SUBSTR(date, 1, INSTR(date, '/') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    CAST(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(date, INSTR(date, '/') + 1), 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(date, INSTR(date, '/') + 1), '/') - 1) AS INTEGER) AS day
  FROM Crime
),
jd AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN month < 3 THEN year - 1
      ELSE year
    END AS y,
    CASE
      WHEN month < 3 THEN month + 12
      ELSE month
    END AS m,
    day
  FROM parsed
),
dow AS (
  SELECT
    ( day
      + ((13 * (m + 1)) / 5)
      + (y % 100)
      + ((y % 100) / 4)
      + ((y / 100) / 4)
      + 5 * (y / 100)
    ) % 7 AS zeller
  FROM jd
)
SELECT
  CASE zeller
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Saturday'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Sunday'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Monday'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Tuesday'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wednesday'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Thursday'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Friday'
  END AS weekday,
  COUNT(*) AS crime_count
FROM dow
GROUP BY weekday
